newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Top Russian general charged with abusing power.
newsitem.headline: Top Russian general charged with abusing power.

text.p: The deputy commander of Russia's ground forces, Colonel General Anton Terentyev, has been charged with fraud and abuse of power, an official in the prosecutor's office said on Tuesday.
The official could give no further details and Terentyev could not be immediately contacted.

Interfax news agency quoted senior assistant military prosecutor Yuri Bagrayev as saying that Terentyev was charged with having used forged documents to register service apartments in Moscow as his property.
Bagrayev told Interfax that Terentyev had been suspended from his office after the charges were formally moved on Monday and ordered not to leave Moscow until the end of the investigation.
The commander-in-chief of the ground forces, Army General Vladimir Semyonov, was suspended from his duties last November on charges which have not been disclosed.
Defence Minister Igor Rodionov has vowed to root out widespread abuse of power and corruption in the Russian military.
